meaning: VARIANTS fixes the set of pulsatility conditions the notebook builds and pairs up, so every deck is rendered and compared under exactly "pulsatile" and "nonpulsatile". A run whose pulsatility label is not one of these two names is not selected for plotting or comparison.

could_move.what: Which variant curves appear in each comparison deck figure, e.g. jugular_compression_m1_vs_m4 and postural_changes_m3_vs_m4
The other consumer of VARIANTS later in the same script may loop over a different variant count than the decks actually produced

Patient decks jugular_compression_m4_vs_m5_p081/p083/p137 are named with a trailing _p0NN, which COMPARISON's _m\d+_vs_[a-z0-9]+$ does not appear to match; whether they are selected as comparisons at all is unclear from this context
The Julia entry point drives these deck runs, so a variant name mismatch surfaces as missing panels rather than an error

expectation: Unknown in size. Direction: a variant present in run output but absent from this tuple is dropped from figures and from comparison metrics; the h-sweep decks (m4_*_h_Pabdo_sweep etc.) may carry no pulsatility axis, in which case one of the two variants is empty.

check.why: Shows every place the two variant names are produced and consumed, so a name that exists in the run but not in VARIANTS (or the reverse) is visible without re-fitting.
